# n8n Balloon Challenges

> Hands-on n8n automation challenges for people learning by building working workflows, available in English, Spanish, and Ukrainian.

The site contains automation challenges, learning articles, and community events. Challenge pages include scenarios, tasks, preparation, requirements, tips, and bonus tasks. Use the language version that matches the reader's preference.

## Main content

- [English homepage and challenge catalog](https://n8n-challenges.app/en): Browse the challenges and learn how the balloon challenge format works.
- [Blog](https://n8n-challenges.app/en/blog): Articles about n8n and automation.
- [Events](https://n8n-challenges.app/en/events): Community events and hackathons.

## Other languages

- [Spanish homepage and challenge catalog](https://n8n-challenges.app/es)
- [Spanish blog](https://n8n-challenges.app/es/blog)
- [Spanish events](https://n8n-challenges.app/es/events)
- [Ukrainian homepage and challenge catalog](https://n8n-challenges.app/uk)
- [Ukrainian blog](https://n8n-challenges.app/uk/blog)
- [Ukrainian events](https://n8n-challenges.app/uk/events)
